title: My Morning Routine
summaryZh: 作者描述平日早上的固定作息，從起床、吃早餐到搭公車上班。

sentences.text: I wake up at six thirty every single morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上六點半起床。
sentences.note: wake up 連讀成 /weɪkʌp/；at 弱讀成 /ət/。

sentences.text: My alarm is loud, so I get up fast.
sentences.zh: 我的鬧鐘很大聲，所以我很快就起來了。
sentences.note: get up → /ɡɛɾʌp/，t 夾在母音之間變成閃音。

sentences.text: First, I drink a big glass of cold water.
sentences.zh: 首先，我會喝一大杯冰水。
sentences.note: glass of 的 of 弱讀成 /əv/；water 的 t 是閃音 /ˈwɔɾɚ/。

sentences.text: Then I open the window and look outside.
sentences.zh: 接著我會打開窗戶往外看。

sentences.text: The street is quiet, and the sky is bright.
sentences.zh: 街道很安靜，天空很明亮。

sentences.text: I take a hot shower for about ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 我會洗大概十分鐘的熱水澡。
sentences.note: for about → /fɚəbaʊt/，for 弱讀，兩字要連讀。

sentences.text: After that, I make coffee and two eggs.
sentences.zh: 洗完後，我會煮咖啡、煎兩顆蛋。

sentences.text: I eat breakfast while I read the morning news.
sentences.zh: 我會一邊吃早餐一邊看早間新聞。

sentences.text: My cat sits on the table and watches me.
sentences.zh: 我的貓會坐在桌上看著我。

sentences.text: Then I brush my teeth and get my bag.
sentences.zh: 然後我會刷牙，拿起我的包包。

sentences.text: I leave my house at exactly seven forty five.
sentences.zh: 我七點四十五分準時出門。
sentences.note: forty 的 t 是閃音 /ˈfɔɹɾi/，重音在第一音節，跟 fourteen 不同。

sentences.text: The bus stop is only two minutes from here.
sentences.zh: 公車站離這裡只要兩分鐘。

sentences.text: I always take the same bus into the city.
sentences.zh: 我總是搭同一班公車進城。
sentences.note: into the → /ˈɪnɾə ðə/，into 的 t 弱化成閃音。

sentences.text: I get to my office before nine every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都在九點前到辦公室。

sentences.text: This simple routine keeps my whole day calm.
sentences.zh: 這個簡單的作息讓我一整天都很平靜。

options: Drinks a big glass of water
